title: Planning a lock or concurrency story gives each recovery path a planted check, not only the contended happy path
goal: A planned story that adds a lock or other concurrency guard carries a check per recovery path its design has (a stale lock cleared while other writers contend, a failure between creating the lock and releasing it), each driven on a planted interleaving; seen in SP-ilqhjn3k, where ST-bu3ppwnx's one check ran six contended writers and a single-process stale clear, and the review then found a stale-clear race that hands one lock to two writers (BG-h6aqngbp) and a lock leaked on a failed owner write (BG-u7gtwn5s)
